{
  "anomaly_detected": true,
  "confidence": 0.5,
  "anomalies": [
    {
      "category": "wrong_value",
      "components": ["R5", "R12", "T2", "R1"],
      "pins": ["R5.1", "R5.2", "T2.1", "R12.1", "R12.2"],
      "nets": ["/G_{PUMP}", "+3V3", "/G_{ATO}", "GND"],
      "observed": "R5 (10k) pulls the main-pump MOSFET gate net /G_{PUMP} up to +3V3. The gate of T2 (IRLR2905) therefore sits at 3.3 V whenever IO10 (via R1) is not actively driving it low. The analogous ATO gate net /G_{ATO} is pulled down to GND by R12 (10k), so the two gate networks use opposite default states.",
      "expected": "Both low-side N-MOSFET gates should default to OFF. The pump gate should be pulled down to GND, as the ATO gate is, so the 24 V main pump does not run at power-up, during reset, or while the GPIO is high-impedance.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"R5\") (pin \"2\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"R5\") (pin \"1\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"R12\") (pin \"1\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "R5 /GPUMP +3V3 10k"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "R12 0 /GATO 10k"}
      ],
      "impact": "The main circulation pump (24 V) can energise at power-up, during ESP32 boot or reset, or whenever the firmware does not actively pull PUMP_MAIN low. This is an unintended actuation hazard for the nutrient and pump system.",
      "confidence": 0.5
    },
    {
      "category": "open_connection",
      "components": ["U1"],
      "pins": ["U1.2"],
      "nets": ["unconnected-(U1-EN-Pad2)"],
      "observed": "The enable pin (EN, pin 2) of the TPS62933 buck converter U1 is not connected to any net. It is carried only as a no-connect flag.",
      "expected": "The EN pin should be tied to VIN for always-on operation, or driven by a defined level or pull resistor. A floating enable pin is undefined in the datasheet.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"136\") (name \"unconnected-(U1-EN-Pad2)\") (class \"Default\")"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"U1\") (pin \"2\") (pinfunction \"EN\") (pintype \"input+no_connect\"))"}
      ],
      "impact": "If the EN pin has no defined default, the 5 V rail that powers the ESP32 and the 3.3 V LDO may fail to start reliably or may behave unpredictably.",
      "confidence": 0.25
    }
  ],
  "summary": "The most likely anomaly is R5, a 10k pull-up from the main-pump MOSFET gate to +3V3, which is the opposite of the pull-down used on the ATO gate and would let the 24 V pump run by default. A lower-confidence concern is the unconnected EN pin on the 5 V buck regulator U1."
}

anomalies.observed: R5 (10k) pulls the main-pump MOSFET gate net /G_{PUMP} up to +3V3. The gate of T2 (IRLR2905) therefore sits at 3.3 V whenever IO10 (via R1) is not actively driving it low. The analogous ATO gate net /G_{ATO} is pulled down to GND by R12 (10k), so the two gate networks use opposite default states.
anomalies.expected: Both low-side N-MOSFET gates should default to OFF. The pump gate should be pulled down to GND, as the ATO gate is, so the 24 V main pump does not run at power-up, during reset, or while the GPIO is high-impedance.
anomalies.impact: The main circulation pump (24 V) can energise at power-up, during ESP32 boot or reset, or whenever the firmware does not actively pull PUMP_MAIN low. This is an unintended actuation hazard for the nutrient and pump system.

anomalies.observed: The enable pin (EN, pin 2) of the TPS62933 buck converter U1 is not connected to any net. It is carried only as a no-connect flag.
anomalies.expected: The EN pin should be tied to VIN for always-on operation, or driven by a defined level or pull resistor. A floating enable pin is undefined in the datasheet.
anomalies.impact: If the EN pin has no defined default, the 5 V rail that powers the ESP32 and the 3.3 V LDO may fail to start reliably or may behave unpredictably.
